original_protocol.question: Does full-state terminal recoverability distinguish matched-volume histories and improve causal action selection against matched and continuous open-loop baselines?
original_protocol.uncertainty_pattern: rectangular K x K: independent adversarial choice each interval
original_protocol.observation: full state exact at boundaries, no disturbance identity supplied
original_protocol.nominal_guard: Nominal composition/biomass objective with the same all-scenario physical admissibility guard
original_protocol.open_grid: Exhaustive robust economic two-feed common plan if feasible; otherwise minimax terminal-error plan; commit both feeds
original_protocol.open_replan: Same first decision as open_grid; robust one-step economic/minimax replan at observed next state
original_protocol.recovery_economic: Causal finite-game guaranteed-biomass optimum over terminal-band-feasible policies; minimax fallback if empty
original_protocol.recovery_filter: Two nominal constant-feed probes (zero and shared-horizon volume cap), affine terminal-ratio interpolation, projected then quantized proposal; accept safe, else nearest safe with economic/error/index tie breaks, else minimax fallback
original_protocol.fallback_claim: No guarantee of terminal-band recovery when safe action set is empty
original_protocol.primary_deployment: All 9 KxK paths, independent physical-amount DOP853, second decision recomputed at actual independently integrated full state
original_protocol.root_initialization: Engine-generated roots define primary initial states. Independent prefix replay separately assesses root provenance with fixed tolerances.

dense_target_map.role: descriptive recovery map; no post hoc target selection or efficacy denominator

original_protocol.nested_grid_subset: All 6 uniform-history roots x 6 fixed targets; 11,21,41 raw actions
original_protocol.continuous_open_subset: All 6 uniform-history roots x 6 fixed targets; two SLSQP minimax starts and optional feasible economic polish, max60iterations each; retain every evaluated incumbent; local baseline only
original_protocol.ood_subset: All 6 uniform-history roots x 6 fixed targets x 5methods x4 stresses =720episodes, descriptive separate from primary finite-game claims
original_protocol.analysis: Complete denominators; paired finite-panel counts and exact worst-case values; no population significance or random-sampling CI for designed cases. Conditional biomass comparisons disclose jointly feasible denominator and family splits. Offline tree and proposal costs included, no real-time acceleration claim.
original_protocol.limitations: Finite actions and finite uncertainty only. Full-state exact sensing. No validated integration enclosure, biological controller validation, continuous-control infeasibility proof, general recursive feasibility, or novel Bellman theorem claim.
original_protocol.development_seen: Two manual analytic baseline states and one manual runtime root, fixed engine validation panel; no generated evaluation root/target outcomes were inspected before freezing.

audit.checkpoints: Three shared first-step states and all nine final paths, chained from the declared root state
audit.label_checks: Report inner, outer and actual-acceptance labels separately; any disagreement remains visible
audit.classifications: Solver convergence status is separate from validity of the retained candidate

scope: Prespecified continuous local baseline on 36 uniform-root/target problems; no global optimum or controller-speed inference
